summary: WARNING: Some search results were malformed or lacked a usable evidence URL and were omitted. Today’s search identified several active, under‑40 k‑mile used SUVs in the Philadelphia/southeast PA–South Jersey–central NJ area that meet the criteria. Strong new candidates include a Certified Pre‑Owned 2022 Subaru Forester Premium (≈14 k mi) and a used 2022 Honda CR‑V EX‑L AWD (~27 324 mi). Baseline vehicles (Mazda CX‑5 Carbon Edition AWD and 2020 Toyota RAV4 LE AWD) remain active. No hybrids surfaced with compelling recent reliability data, so not included.
